practice.primary_question: Why can a BJT collector current be much lower than beta times base current?
practice.typical_exam_trap: Applying Ic = βIb without checking whether the collector circuit can support that current.

case_dna.target_misconception: Applying Ic = βIb without checking whether the collector circuit can support that current.
case_dna.why_plausible: A familiar simplified electronics relation is easy to apply without checking the assumptions that make it valid.
case_dna.contradicting_evidence: βIb predicts 100 mA, but the collector loop allows only about 48 mA; therefore the BJT is saturated and Ic is circuit-limited.
